notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 5 p. 245-246: Knobelsdorff "ordered General Priess, who, as commander of the XIII SS Corps, was directing operations in this sector, to throw everything he had into a resumption of the attack on 27 September"; "Priess selected the village of Moncel, on the Nancy-Dieuze highway, as the initial objective".
